xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs:
1st Disclosure on August 8, 2023
The Company has received a Show Cause Notice (SCN) dated July 26, 2023 on August 8, 2023 from Directorate General of GST Intelligence, New Delhi alleging a tax demand of₹ 273,44,50,284/- under Section 74(1) of the Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 (‘the Act) along with interest under Section 50(1) of the Act and penalty under Section 74(1) read with Section 122(2)(b) of the Act.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr:
The Company has informed stock exchanges vide intimation dated February 1, 2025 regarding receipt of an order on February 1,2025 from Additional Commissioner of CGST & Central Excise, Palghar Commissionerate with respect to aforesaid SCN confirming tax demand of ₹ 273,44,50,284/- under Section 74 of the Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 (‘the Act’) along with interest u/s 50 and levying a penalty of ₹ 273,44,50,284/- under Section 74 read with Section 122 of the Act for the period July 2017 to March 2022 covering various states.
The Company would pursue an appeal with Appellate Authorities/evaluate other legal options against the said Order including filing a Writ Petition.
The matter largely relates to an industry wide issue with respect to applicability of GST on salvage and ineligible Input Tax Credit, on motor claims settled.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: Deputy Commissioner, Circle-I, Jaipur–III, AC/CTO Ward, Rajasthan.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: Intimation dated December 31, 2023 filed with Stock Exchanges informing about the receipt of Order.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr:
The Company has opted for amnesty scheme (‘the Scheme’) under Goods and Services Tax (‘GST’), inserted vide Section 128A of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 (‘the Act’), to facilitate the resolution of pending GST disputes, in respect of the referred orders, for the period July 2017 to March 2020.
In this regard, the Company on March 26, 2025 has made payment of total tax demand aggregating to ₹15,34,978/- pertaining to referred order and will be filing the requisite application for waiver of interest and penalty under the Scheme. The Company has also made disclosure to stock exchanges on March 26, 2025 in this regard.
The Company’s application under the Scheme would be subject to verification by GST authorities.
This settlement will result in recognition and payment of one-time tax liability of ₹15,34,978/- which was earlier disclosed under Contingent Liability. The Contingent Liability related to these matters will get reduced to NIL. Beside this there is no material impact on the operations or activities of the Company with respect to the above.
